title.zh: 将本格特省阿科普、图布莱、卡潘甘—基邦岸—巴昆—西尼普西普至布吉亚斯次级国家公路更名为Bado Dangwa州长国家公路的法案
title.en: An Act Renaming the Acop, Tublay, Kapangan - Kibungan - Bakun - Sinipsip, Buguias Secondary National Road in the Province of Benguet to Gov. Bado Dangwa National Road
title.orig: An Act Renaming the Acop, Tublay, Kapangan - Kibungan - Bakun - Sinipsip, Buguias Secondary National Road in the Province of Benguet to Gov. Bado Dangwa National Road

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2018/ra_11042_2018.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: In recognition of her public service rendered to the people of the Province of Benguet as a distinguished soldier during the Japanese occupation, businessman, leader and pre-martial law governor, the Acop, Tublay, Kapangan - Kibungan - Bakun - Sinipsip, Bungias Secondary National Road is renamed as the Gov. Bado Dangwa National Road.

The Department of Public Works and Highways shall place appropriate markers along the Gov. Bado Dangwa National Road and issue the necessary orders and circulars to implement the provision of this Act.
This Act shall take effect immediately upon its approval.
